messages:
riley_docs: heads-up i opened a small docs PR that adds a console observability example for per-route cost/latency. playground preview failed with a 400 on trace ingest. can someone eyeball?

tara_sdk: link?

riley_docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620 — preview job: `playground-render` shows ingest 400. snippet sets env `TRACE_TOKEN` which our SDK expects as `TRACE_KEY`.

ops_mike: yep that's the mismatch. also noticed the dashboard example references `billing_usd` field; our export uses `cost_cents` for now. small rename needed in the YAML.

riley_docs: thanks — i'll update both. would be great to include a 1-line Go snippet that extracts trace route metadata for attribution.

tara_sdk: quick Go example: ```go
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "os"
  "github.com/redwood-inference/sdk"
)
func main(){
  client := sdk.New(os.Getenv("TRACE_KEY"))
  t, _ := client.LatestTrace()
  fmt.Printf("route=%s latency_ms=%d\n", t.Metadata["route"], t.LatencyMs)
}
```

riley_docs: perfect, i'll add that inline. i'll also change `billing_usd` -> `cost_cents` and add a note to divide by 100 for UI display.

preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://playground.redwood.test/pr-4620-preview (expires in 24h)

ops_mike: when you push the patch, consider adding a tiny smoke step to the docs CI to POST a test trace to the sandbox ingest so we catch bad env var names earlier.

riley_docs: good idea — added a follow-up commit with `docs: add snippet-smoke job` and pushed. will re-run preview after CI completes.

tara_sdk: LGTM once CI is green. thanks for catching the export field mismatch.

riley_docs: thanks all, will merge after green and follow up in the migration notes about `cost_cents` naming. :rocket:
